Enhance `super_len` to count encoded bytes for str

This is a possible fix for issue #6586.

I am not at all confident that this is an appropriate change for Requests. All of the unit tests pass locally for me (specifically `make ci`).

"TOO_EARLY" type definition for status code 425

Addressing issue #6584:
- Added "too_early" to type definition of status code 425
- Added tests for retrieving 425 when querying type definitions
- In accordance with RFC 4918 and 8470.
